projects.title: Support for Cancer Patients & Orphans
projects.desc: Medical treatment and diagnostics, psychological support events, and orphan support (education grants, food baskets, holiday clothing).

projects.title: Dr. Hala Saeed's Charitable Project
projects.funding: With Latakia Governorate, Syria Trust for Development, Souria Btjmana
projects.desc: Launched on 8 Feb 2023 after the earthquake, in memory of the doctors who lost their lives. Food, medicine, shelter and relief supplies, while still supporting cancer patients.

projects.title: Supporting & Empowering Children with Cancer
projects.desc: Psychosocial and recreational support, educational support, and awareness sessions for the families of children with cancer.

projects.title: Psychological Support Room Rehabilitation
projects.desc: Turned a gloomy hospital room into a safe, colorful activity space for children with cancer with a very small budget.

projects.title: Educational Sessions Program
projects.desc: Closing learning gaps caused by long treatment, at the headquarters, in hospital or at home. Children who completed middle and high school certificates in 2024 were honored.

projects.title: Medical Program
projects.desc: Free chemotherapy and diagnostics (PET, MRI, CT, tumor markers, histopathology with IHC, bone marrow and genetic testing) for pediatric and adult cancer patients.

projects.title: Childhood Cancer Awareness Campaign
projects.desc: Global Childhood Cancer Awareness Month campaign covering eight schools and several children's activity centers, supported by a media campaign.

projects.title: "You Are Stronger Than Cancer" Campaign
projects.desc: Launched at the Cancer Survivor Ceremony to highlight survivor stories and give hope and determination to current patients.

projects.title: Coastal Disaster Relief
projects.desc: Relief aid for victims of multiple disasters in the Syrian coastal region, including necessities for the elderly and children.

projects.title: Celebrations & Recreational Events
projects.desc: Christmas, Eid al-Fitr, Eid al-Adha and World Cancer Day events for children with cancer and orphans, with partner organizations, plus yoga and sports activities.

research.title: IgG fusion proteins for neurological disease
research.desc: Narrative review on IgG fusion proteins as a blood-brain barrier-crossing platform for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's, with prospects for stroke and TBI. Focus on CD98hc, insulin and transferrin receptors. Presented orally during the ICGEB/AEC course.

research.title: Novel protein design for acute stroke
research.desc: Collaborative design of a novel protein for acute stroke, tested in silico with computational analysis of its protein folding.

research.title: Global Neurotrauma Outcomes Study: Spine
research.desc: Leader of the data collection team at Tishreen University Hospital for the NIHR Global Health Research Group on Neurotrauma.

research.title: Pediatric oncology records
research.desc: Organized and standardized the medical records of ~200 pediatric oncology patients at the Cancer Research Center to support future retrospective studies. The workflow was sustained later through Ma'ak.

research.title: Breast cancer awareness on the Syrian coast
research.desc: Cross-sectional study published in Annals of Medicine & Surgery.

research.title: Neuromatch-based research project
research.desc: Building a computational neuroscience research project following the Neuromatch Academy course.

training.title: Fusion Protein Biotechnology: Design, Application and Innovation
training.detail: Atomic Energy Commission of Syria & ICGEB · Damascus · 7.5 h theory + 20 h practical. Cloning, mammalian cell culture, FPLC purification, Western blot, ELISA.

training.title: Introduction to Bioinformatics (IBT2026)
training.detail: African Bioinformatics Institute & AfriGen-D · 72-hour online program: databases, Linux, alignment, phylogenetics, genomics.

training.title: Computational Neuroscience
training.detail: Neuromatch Academy · Model fitting, GLMs, dimensionality reduction, deep learning, dynamical systems, Bayesian decisions, reinforcement learning, network causality.

training.title: Digital Brain Twins in Clinical Research
Brain Stroke and Neuro ICU
training.detail: SAMS Institute · On-site · ASPECTS, mRS, NIHSS, intensive care for stroke patients.

training.title: Critical Care Course (24 hours)
training.detail: On-site · ICU liberation, pain and agitation, delirium, sedation, sleep promotion, mechanical ventilation, sepsis.

training.title: Childhood Adversity: Impact of Maltreatment on Mental Health
